release_notes:
Improved Stripe checkout receipts and product details

- Stripe purchases now show a clear product image, price, and quantity
  on your receipt, plus a recognizable name on your card/bank statement
  — matching the PayPal experience.
- Admins can turn on an itemized Stripe invoice (emailed automatically)
  per payment method, for customers who want a formal PDF invoice.
- Purchases are now correctly categorized as a physical product rather
  than a digital service, for smoother card processing.
- Product wording on PayPal and Stripe now consistently describes the
  physical prepaid card being shipped.
